snippet.title: Frog Legs Release Date Trailer
snippet.description:
https://store.steampowered.com/app/1734110/Frog_Legs/
What if Resident Evil and Frogger had a boomer shooter baby? Then you'd get Frog Legs, a new horror-action game by The Man in the Park creator, Elliott Dahle. Coming May 19, 2025.
